Northern Thailand corridor

Chiang Mai is the base. Chiang Rai is a day or two for the White Temple and the Mekong. Pai is a mountain night if you accept the winding road.

HubChiang Mai Old City and Nimman
Side tripChiang Rai in one long day or one night
LoopMae Hong Son is a 3-4 day motorbike or van circuit

Fly into CNX or take SRT trains 9 and 10 from Krung Thep Aphiwat in Bangkok. The sleeper is the useful one.

Do not add Pai and Chiang Rai and the full loop on a first week. Pick one fork from Chiang Mai.

Is Pai worth the drive?
Only if you want a mountain night and accept 3 to 4 hours of switchbacks. It is not a first-week must.
